ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Social_Event', OR( AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Initial Inquiry')) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled')), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Initial Inquiry'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Consultation Scheduled'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Consultation Scheduled'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Consultation Completed'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Consultation Completed'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Proposal Sent'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Proposal Sent'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Confirmed'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Confirmed'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'In Planning'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'In Planning'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Executing'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Executing'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Completed'), TRUE), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Cancelled'), TRUE) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status transition. Social Events must follow the sequence: Initial Inquiry → Consultation Scheduled → Consultation Completed → Proposal Sent → Confirmed → In Planning → Executing → Completed. No skipping or reverting is allowed.
